description: Make an authenticated request to an arbitrary Onshape REST endpoint, for anything the dedicated tools do not cover. Paths start with /api/ and are documented at https://cad.onshape.com/glassworks/explorer. Prefer a dedicated tool when one exists — they normalise the response and validate the result.

path.description: API path, e.g. /api/v6/documents/d/{did}/w/{wid}/elements. Must begin with /api/.

name: onshape_request
title: Call any Onshape REST endpoint
